payload.claim: The "Notes for the agent" reminder about the prose gate ("Write none with an em dash, a semicolon, a contraction, the perfect tense or a sentence over 25 words") is true but incomplete: .saffron/gates/prose.py also enforces a hedge-word rule (should/may/might), a filler-word rule, a mid-sentence if/when rule, a 2-line comment-block limit, and a 10-line docstring limit, none of which the reminder mentions, even though the cell's new docstring sentence and branch comments remain bound by them.
